candidates.description: This feature vector represents characters and phonemes from the Japanese and Hindi writing systems.
This vector is related to numbers in the one-hundred-eighties range.
This feature vector activates on a random assortment of multilingual text fragments, punctuation marks, and HTML tag components without a cohesive semantic theme.
These tokens represent various combinations of Hindi consonants combined with different vowel diacritics.
These tokens represent non-English or foreign-language character fragments and diacritics.
This vector activates on various Hindi vowel signs and punctuation marks attached to commas.
This vector represents common Hindi vowel matras (dependent vowel signs) combined with punctuation marks or trailing characters.
This vector activates strongly for Hindi and Devanagari script characters alongside specific consonants and numbers.
This vector is related to uppercase acronyms, state abbreviations, and single-letter token fragments.
This vector activates on fragments and characters from multilingual proper nouns, loanwords, and mixed-script text tokens.
